characters.summary: Eobard Thawne is a ruthless speedster who weaponizes the Negative Speed Force to run through time, phase through matter, and devastate enemies with temporal paradoxes.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to positive Speed Force suppression
limitations: Requires connection to the Negative Speed Force to maintain reality-warping abilities
Vulnerable to paradoxical erasure if his own past is disrupted

sources.supports: General background and powers of Eobard Thawne
Negative Speed Force usage, intangibility, and notable feats

feats.claim: Traveled through time to alter Barry Allen's childhood history.
Phased his hand through a victim's chest to stop their heart.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Barry utilized the positive Speed Force to overcome him.

campaignTags.claim: Thawne can hover and fly using the Negative Speed Force.
He heals from fatal wounds almost instantly through temporal reversion.
Thawne travels through time and across dimensions using super-speed.

unknowns: Exact limits of his paradox immunity across various continuity reboots.

characters.summary: Edward Nygma is a master puzzle-maker and intellect who relies on complex death traps, forensic manipulation, and psychological games to challenge Batman.
weaknesses: Compulsive need to leave riddles and clues
limitations: Lacks superhuman physical durability or strength
Obsession with intellectual superiority often leads to his downfall

sources.supports: General profile and psychological traits of the Riddler

feats.claim: Took over Gotham City's infrastructure during Zero Year.

notableResults.note: Batman outsmarted his trap and exposed his scheme.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes question-mark canes equipped with Tasers and gas capsules.
Designs intricate mechanical death traps and puzzles.

unknowns: Whether his temporary reform periods permanently altered his criminal tendencies.

characters.summary: Damian Wayne is the lethal, highly trained son of Batman and Talia al Ghul who fights with elite martial arts, swords, and stealth techniques.
weaknesses: Internal conflict regarding his lethal upbringing

sources.supports: Background, training by League of Assassins, and skills

feats.claim: Defeated multiple adult League of Assassins members in single combat.
Briefly held the mantle of Batman using fear tactics.

notableResults.note: Overpowered due to Dick's superior experience.

campaignTags.claim: Trained by the League of Assassins to move silently and remain unseen.
Carries standard Robin utility belt items including grapples and shuriken.
Uses cape to glide short distances.

unknowns: Extent of his mystical demon-revival enhancements.

characters.summary: Brother Saint Walker is a member of the Blue Lantern Corps who harnesses the blue light of hope to inspire allies, heal wounds, and weaken red and yellow rings.

mechanisms: Enhanced durability via Blue Lantern ring

weaknesses: Ring power diminishes when separated from a Green Lantern's proximity
Cannot create offensive hard-light constructs without a Green Lantern nearby
limitations: Power severely restricted without a Green Lantern nearby
Strictly prohibited from using lethal force by ring programming

sources.supports: Origin and abilities of Saint Walker
Blue Lantern ring powers, healing, and limitations

feats.claim: Pacified an entire population gripped by rage on his home planet.
feats.citation: Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1

feats.claim: Overcharged Hal Jordan's Green Lantern ring with hope energy.

notableResults.note: Calmed Atrocitus's rage by feeding him hope.

conditional.dependsOn: Proximity to an active Green Lantern ring

campaignTags.claim: Can fly using his Blue Lantern ring.
Can heal injuries and reverse aging effects using hope constructs.
Restores and heals allies in combat.

unknowns: Full potential of the blue light when used independently of other corps.

characters.summary: Jonathan Crane is a biochemist and psychologist who weaponizes fear toxin to induce crippling hallucinations and paralyzing terror in his targets.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical attacks when caught in close combat

sources.supports: General profile, fear toxin, and background
Detailed toxin formulas and combat methods

feats.claim: Subdued entire blocks of Gotham City with airborne fear gas.
Transformed into the monster 'Scarebeast' using enhanced chemical concoctions.

notableResults.note: Defeated after Batman developed immunity or countermeasures to his toxin.

campaignTags.claim: Uses spray canisters, pellets, and syringes filled with fear toxin.

unknowns: Whether his chemical mutations leave permanent physical side effects.

characters.summary: Billy Batson transforms by uttering a magic word into Shazam, gaining the wisdom of Solomon, strength of Hercules, stamina of Atlas, power of Zeus, courage of Achilles, and speed of Mercury.
weaknesses: Risk of reverting to a child if forced to speak the magic word or struck by his own lightning
limitations: Retains the mental maturity and temperament of a teenager unless using Solomon's wisdom
Can be tricked into speaking his own name to revert to Billy Batson

sources.supports: Origin, magic word, and pantheon attributes
Powers, Zeus lightning, and superhuman feats

feats.claim: Stalemated Superman in physical combat using magic-enhanced strength.
Lifted a bridge supporting heavy transit traffic.

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill before intervening to save others.

campaignTags.claim: Summons and projects magical lightning from the heavens.
Transforms via divine magic word invocation.
Empowered entirely by ancient mythological gods.

unknowns: Exact upper limits of his durability against high-tier reality warpers.

characters.summary: King Shazam is a corrupted version of Billy Batson infused with the powers of the Infected, wielding amplified magical abilities and subservient to the Dark Multiverse.
weaknesses: Susceptibility to light-based or purified cosmic energy
Psychological corruption by the Batman Who Laughs
characters.formDifferences: King Shazam replaces Billy Batson's standard altruistic persona with a cruel, corrupted mindset loyal to the Batman Who Laughs, amplifying his magical output with dark energy.

sources.supports: King Shazam transformation, infection by Batman Who Laughs, and feats

unknowns: Whether the infection permanently alters the Shazam pantheon connection.

characters.summary: Thaal Sinestro is a former Green Lantern turned master wielder of the yellow light of fear, constructing devastating hard-light weapons and leveraging terror to dominate opponents.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to willpower-based constructs (historically, though overcome)
Reliance on his Sinestro Corps power ring and central battery charge
limitations: Ring requires periodic recharging via power battery
Arrogance and over-reliance on fear subjugation

sources.supports: History, Yellow Lantern ring powers, and tactics
Construct creation, fear manipulation, and notable battles

feats.claim: Subdued multiple Green Lanterns simultaneously using fear constructs.
feats.citation: Green Lantern Corps: Sinestro Corps War

feats.claim: Bound and tortured Kyle Rayner to extract entity data.

notableResults.note: Defeated after Hal overcame his fear and destroyed his initial wave of constructs.

campaignTags.claim: Flies through space and atmosphere via his Yellow Power Ring.

unknowns: Full extent of his control over Parallax once separated.
